title: Logistic Regression with Gradient Descent
signature: def logistic_regression_gd(X: np.ndarray, y: np.ndarray, lr: float, n_iters: int) -> tuple
hints: For the mean binary cross-entropy, the gradient with respect to the logits is (p - y) / n.
So dw = X^T (p - y) / n and db = mean(p - y). Update both together.
exp(z) / (1 + exp(z)) is inf / inf = nan when z is large. Evaluate the sigmoid with exp(-|z|), which never overflows.
